en: The image shows the front and back of a vintage postcard. The front depicts a formal garden with circular flower beds, a central fountain, and lush greenery. The bottom left contains the printed words 'LJUBLJANA Tivolski bazeni' and the bottom right 'LAIBACH Tivoli-Park', indicating a bilingual (Slovenian/German) description. The back of the card has handwritten text, a green postage stamp, and postal markings, including the name 'Laibach', which is the historical German name for Ljubljana.
